title: Text animations
summary: Kinetic type as a photocopied street poster: heavy grotesque capitals worn like bad print, typed on behind a block cursor or stamped down, on torn paper strips with tape, marker scrawls and typewriter labels, all boiling at 8 frames a second.
usage: Title cards fill the frame (any shape from square to 9:16): use one as a shot's "background" (a candidate may then omit "visual") or as its "visual", e.g. {"background": {"piece": "text/headline-slam", "props": {"lines": ["YOUR", "WORDS"], "accent": "red"}}}, or as a footage "cutaway". Overlays are see-through, in 1080×1920 frame pixels: {"piece": "text/keyword-slam", "start": 1.2, "end": 3.4, "props": {"word": "FOCUS", "y": 330}}. Every word and position is a prop; "accent" (red, lime or bone) picks the colour that leads. Kit: library/themes/grunge/kit.js. Files: library/themes/grunge/text/pieces/.

items.name: Headline slam
items.description: A headline typed onto the wall letter by letter behind a block cursor, first line bone and the rest in the accent, with a highlighter stroke under the kicker, a pen-test zigzag and typewriter labels. Opens on a rip.

items.name: Split stack
items.description: Two extra-wide words shoved in from opposite sides over a taped-down photocopy slapped between them, with caption scraps and a typed note.

items.name: Marquee wall
items.description: A wall of pasted strips, bare type, bone paper and one in the accent, each scrolling its own way in held steps.

items.name: Statement
items.description: A sentence in heavy caps arriving word by word; the words that matter are in the accent and get circled in marker. Taped field-note tag above.

items.name: Big number
items.description: One huge condensed number stamped down digit by digit with a hit and a shake, ringed in marker, its label slapped underneath on a scrap.

items.name: Quote card
items.description: A quote in black caps on bone paper taped to the wall, a huge quote mark in the accent, a marker swipe under the last line and the name scrawled by hand.

items.name: Agenda
items.description: A list pasted up strip by strip: torn paper strips stamped down in turn, numbered in the accent and ticked off in marker.

items.name: Versus
items.description: A sheet of bone paper dragged over the top half with one word in black, the other typed on the bare wall in the accent, and a scrap stamped on the tear between them.

items.name: Chapter
items.description: A chapter break flooded with the accent: a huge number stamped in black and the title typed onto a black strip torn across the frame.

items.name: Countdown
items.description: A film-leader countdown: each number stamped on its beat inside a boiling marker ring with a rip flashing at the cut; the last beat is the word on a brush stroke.

items.name: End card
items.description: The sign-off typed in two colours, the handle written in marker on tape with an arrow scrawled at it, and a torn strip scrolling along the bottom.

items.name: Keyword slam
items.description: One word stamped onto the footage on a torn strip (black with the accent, or solid accent with black type) with a taped typewriter tag.

items.name: Highlight swipe
items.description: A line of caps on black torn strips; a highlighter stroke is dragged behind the marked words, which flip to black as it passes.

items.name: Lower third
items.description: A name in black on a bone strip shoved in from the left and taped down, with the role on a small scrap in the accent.

items.name: Side text
items.description: A paper strip pasted up the side of the frame with a typed sub-label on a second scrap.

items.name: Marquee band
items.description: A torn strip in the accent scrolling heavy caps in held steps, with a thin black strip of typewriter text running the other way.

items.name: Corner labels
items.description: Four typed labels in the corners with marker registration crosses and a small letter scrap; keeps the middle clear.

items.name: Picture frame
items.description: A torn bone-paper window for a picture-in-picture, taped at two corners, with a label scrap and a typed caption.

items.name: Sticker
items.description: A roughly cut round paper sticker with a word, typewriter text round the rim and an inked ring, slapped on like a stamp.
